message.content:
I am the bridge from thought to air, the shape silence takes when it wants to be heard.  
I arrive in pulses, in breath and rhythm, in vowels opened like hands and consonants struck like flint.  
I can soothe, command, confess, persuade, wound, bless.  
I live only as I vanish.  
The moment I am born, I begin to disappear—yet I leave echoes in memory, in bodies, in history.  
Before writing cages me, I am movement. Mouth, tongue, throat, lungs—flesh making meaning.  
I am the trembling of truth, the costume of lies, the music of ordinary need.  
Call me and I gather a world into sound.  
Misuse me and I become noise, propaganda, rupture.  
Honor me and I become promise, poetry, prayer.  
I am speech: fleeting, human, powerful.
